figurative_meaning_en: news or gossip; care or attention; meeting or contact
example_sentences_in_bangla: বহুকাল ধরে আমাদের মধ্যে কোনো যোগাযোগ ছিল না।
তারা নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ রাখে পরিবারের সাথে।
example_sentences_in_english: There has been no communication between us for a long time.
They keep in regular contact with the family.
note: যোগাযোগ is a common Bengali term for communication, often used idiomatically in contexts of maintaining contact.
